description: This file defines an interface `EventsTopicPathBuilder` in the package `org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter`. The interface provides methods for building topic paths related to events, specifically for setting actions like created, modified, or deleted, and extends another interface `TopicPathBuildable`. It serves as a contract for implementing classes to generate event-specific topic paths within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter component.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Sets the action of the builder to 'CREATED', replacing any previously set action. Supports method chaining.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Sets the action of the builder to 'MODIFIED', replacing any previously set action. Supports method chaining.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Sets the action of the builder to 'DELETED', replacing any previously set action. Supports method chaining.
